dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.context: Settings row label for height filter pillar visibility mode.

dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.en: Controls how pillar visibility is evaluated when filtering height layers.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.context: Settings row description for height filter pillar visibility mode.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.de: Steuert, wie die Säulensichtbarkeit beim Filtern von Höhenebenen bewertet wird.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.es: Controla cómo se evalúa la visibilidad de los pilares al filtrar capas de altura.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.it: Controlla il modo in cui viene valutata la visibilità dei pilastri durante il filtraggio dei layer di altezza.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.pt: Controla como a visibilidade do pilar é avaliada ao filtrar camadas de altura.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.ru: Управляет тем, как оценивается видимость столбов при фильтрации слоев высот.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.sv: Styr hur pelarens synlighet utvärderas vid filtrering av höjdlager.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.zh: 控制过滤高度图层时如何评估支柱可见性。

dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.en: Detached evaluates each pillar's height independently against the active layer. Attached shows pillars whenever at least one visible transport or elevated structure is attached.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.context: Settings tooltip for height filter pillar visibility options.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.de: Bei „Detached“ wird die Höhe jeder Säule unabhängig von der aktiven Ebene bewertet. „Angehängt“ zeigt Säulen, wenn mindestens eine sichtbare Transport- oder Hochstruktur angebracht ist.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.es: Separado evalúa la altura de cada pilar de forma independiente frente a la capa activa. Adjunto muestra pilares cada vez que se adjunta al menos un transporte visible o una estructura elevada.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.it: Staccato valuta l'altezza di ciascun pilastro in modo indipendente rispetto al livello attivo. In allegato vengono mostrati i pilastri ogni volta che è collegato almeno un trasporto visibile o una struttura elevata.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.pt: Detached avalia a altura de cada pilar independentemente em relação à camada ativa. Anexado mostra pilares sempre que pelo menos um transporte visível ou estrutura elevada estiver anexado.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.ru: Отдельный оценивает высоту каждой колонны независимо от активного слоя. Прикрепленные столбы отображаются всякий раз, когда прикреплен хотя бы один видимый транспорт или надземная конструкция.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.sv: Fristående utvärderar varje pelares höjd oberoende av det aktiva lagret. Bifogad visar pelare när minst en synlig transport eller upphöjd struktur är fäst.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.zh: 分离根据有源层独立评估每个柱的高度。只要至少连接了一个可见的运输或高架结构，就会显示柱子。
